commit.message:
fix(sim): fixture laws pad an arc's chords by its bulge

The box fixture laws (c2)/(d2) swept an arc along its inscribed chords
(Move::segments3 at the chord tolerance) with each band's bare radius.
The circle bulges past every chord by up to its sagitta, so steel in
that sliver went unseen. Measured: an R30 arc with an r3 flute, where the
box face sat half a sagitta inside the true reach, reported no FixtureHit.

The new sim::verify::arc_bulge bounds how far the true path can stand
off each chord: the sagitta r(1 - cos psi) across it and r(psi - sin psi)
along it (fraction-matched, psi <= pi/2; 2r over a half turn), plus
ARC_PAD = 1 um for the lattice-snapped centre.

- stack_span::pieces/band_struck: every arc piece pads the band radius
  (upright column and lean enclosure). In XY the pad is the whole
  deviation. In XZ/YZ it is only the horizontal part. A vertical arc's
  z window is its true z range between joints (joints for Z-monotone
  pieces, carried to the circle's extremum for an unsplit arc), so a
  lead arc landing tangent on a mounting face stays flush and silent.
- posed_steel: an arc move's capsules grow by the 3-D deviation.
- Straight moves pad nothing, so their verdicts are byte-identical. An
  arc with a non-finite centre or radius fails closed.

Pinned by sim fixture_arc_sagitta (10 tests). Every sim suite and every
camcraft-app suite keeps its verdicts.

Fixes #491
